info.text:
The FTC says Amazon called its Prime cancel flow "Iliad" and alleged it took 4 pages, 6 clicks, 15 options to cancel, versus 1-2 clicks to sign up (FTC complaint, 2023).
C+R Research (spring 2022): people guessed $86 a month on subscriptions; itemized, it was $219.
CNET/YouGov (2026): about $252 a year spent on unused subscriptions.
Prime's annual fee: $79 (2005) to $139 (2022), still $139 as of Nov 2026. Our math: a forgotten $14.99-a-month plan costs $179.88 a year.
Rules: California click-to-cancel (July 1, 2025); FTC click-to-cancel rule vacated by the 8th Circuit (July 2025); Amazon's $2.5B FTC settlement under ROSCA, no admission of wrongdoing (Sept 2025); FTC restarted rulemaking (March 2026; no proposed rule as of Nov 2026).
Sources: FTC, C+R Research, CNET/YouGov, Kiplinger, California AB 2863.
News and education, not financial advice.
